sections.section_title: SDMMC IDMA linked list memory base register (SDMMC_IDMABAR)
sections.text_helper: Section 30.10.20 "SDMMC IDMA linked list memory base register (SDMMC_IDMABAR)" in chapter 30 (Secure digital input/output MultiMediaCard interface (SDMMC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1452.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x068
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:2 IDMABA[29:0]: Word aligned Linked list memory base address
Linked list memory base pointer.
These bits can only be written by firmware when DPSM is inactive (DPSMACT = 0).
Bits 1:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
